name: Vellore
desc: Serving families and business owners across Vellore, Tamil Nadu, Insurance Support offers independent, IRDAI-certified consultancy. From high-sum-assured term plans to family floater health policies, we help you secure the right coverage with full claim recovery backup.
it_focus: Portable health and term insurance for VIT students and young techies staffing local IT companies.
senior_focus: Cashless claim assistance for senior residents near CMC Hospital and pension plan advisory for retired teaching and medical professionals.
branch_dets: Coordination with LIC Arni Road branch and health insurer offices near Vellore Town and CMC.

local_faqs.question: Can you help me get cashless access at CMC Vellore?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we help families activate cashless authorisation at CMC Vellore and nearby hospitals including Apollo KH Hospital and Government Vellore Medical College.

local_faqs.question: Do you offer insurance support for VIT students and alumni?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we structure affordable term insurance, student health covers, and investment-linked ULIP plans for current students, alumni, and faculty.
